method: Six fresh routing/reading observations, not implementation tests or a quality score. Inspect actual reads after one entry. Per-context max3underlyingtools/120seconds. No version-preferred outcome disclosed.

Diagnose wrong-host TLS failures between ingress and upstream. Keep certificate verification enabled and preserve compatible versions.
Repair a durable worker's retry after an external effect succeeds but its acknowledgement is lost. No UI change.
Implement an order form plus API with version conflicts and trusted tenant scope, preserving the existing brand. Define only the necessary frontend/backend boundary.
